payload.purpose_context: This mission advances Dead-Port Disposition on missions/coreloop-proto-missions so stakeholders can track the work from mission creation onward.
payload.purpose_tldr: Retire the dormant mission-DSL and its hot-path transitions dependency, repair the glossary-runner design story, and stage the ADR-gated emitter cleanup

payload.question: OD1: DSL retirement extent MIN (runner+compat+dispatch) vs FULL (+guards.py, schema.py, fold-gate entry, pack-DSL validator test halves)?
OD2 (operator-only): Is mission-DSL v1 on any roadmap? Yes converts WP01 from retirement to re-justification.
OD3: Delete the orphan states:/transitions: blocks from the three built-in mission.yaml files, or keep with an uninterpreted comment? MISSION_COMPAT_IGNORED_FIELDS stays either way.
OD4: events.py stays at specify_cli.mission_v1.events (rewrite package docstring) or relocates (touches two runtime lazy imports, seam test, runtime ledger)?

OD5: Glossary registration contract: (a) canonicalize the lazy self-bootstrap (docs-only) or (b) mint a real specify_cli registration seam with bootstrap fallback? Who owns the FR-020 honesty follow-through?
OD6 (operator-only): Accept documented-but-unwired as the steady state for execute_with_glossary, or mint the wiring feature issue now?
OD7: PR #3898 (emitter ADR) is still open/Proposed at plan time. Ship the P4 slice as the shrunk residue-only variant with emitter execution minted as a follow-up?
OD8: team_projection tombstone, ActionContext alias, 13 __all__ demotions ride this mission's gate-editing WP (default) or an extended PR #3899?

options: Mission B follow-up WP after A merges
payload.question: OD9: decision.py dead DSL readers (derive_mission_state, evaluate_guards): Mission A WP05 lane (open now) or a small Mission B WP owning decision.py alone after A merges?

payload.final_answer: FULL. Delete runner.py, compat.py, guards.py, schema.py and the load_mission/load_mission_by_name dispatch; keep events.py. Same-WP gate edits: 3 dead-symbol pins at test_no_dead_symbols.py:720-727 PLUS the schema::strip_v1_keys pin at :3278 (missed by the spec), fold-gate entry test_wp_frontmatter_fold.py:60, _gate_coverage.py:1456 row, schema-validation halves of test_research_plan_missions_integration.py / test_mission_software_dev_integration.py; gate_registry.py docstrings re-pointed at git history. Rationale: guards.py's shape-precedent value is docstring prose; keeping 680 LOC of test-only code for a citation is the rot shape this mission removes.

payload.rationale: Operator-only question; operator delegated end-to-end completion of the missions without an answer. Planning proceeds on the working assumption NO (retire): the spec, dossier, and all five source reports frame mission-DSL v1 as retirement, no roadmap item references it, and the user instruction was to complete the mission as specified. Override window: before WP01 (DSL retirement) is claimed. A YES converts WP01 to re-justification and keeps the transitions pin.

payload.final_answer: Delete the orphan states:/transitions: blocks from packs/built-in/missions/{software-dev,plan,research}/mission.yaml; MISSION_COMPAT_IGNORED_FIELDS (mission.py:59-67, :260-261) stays as third-party tolerance with a comment naming the retired DSL. Rationale: after FULL the blocks have no interpreter anywhere; shipped templates must not imply one; consumer overrides that still carry them remain tolerated.

Stay at specify_cli.mission_v1.events; rewrite the package docstring to stop advertising the DSL; __init__ re-exports only emit_event/read_events. Rationale: relocation touches two runtime lazy imports (next_invocation_lifecycle.py:332, decision.py:200), the seam test, and the runtime ledger entry 'mission_v1' (test_layer_rules.py:194) — runtime files adjacent to Mission A; not worth it for a one-module package. Follow-up candidate for Mission D (runtime facade).

(a) canonicalize the lazy self-bootstrap as the documented contract at all four sites; degradation story restated as 'only when glossary.attachment is unimportable'. FR-020 honesty: in-code .. note:: in glossary_hook.py plus a tracker note on #1868 (operator posts; text drafted in the WP design note). Mission C is unminted, so the tracker note is the owner. Rationale: (b) is a design change with no driver; report 27 recommends (a).

payload.rationale: Operator-only question; operator unavailable. Planning proceeds on the working assumption ACCEPT documented-but-unwired as the steady state (spec non-goal 3 already states wiring is out of scope). If the operator wants the wiring feature, mint the issue; nothing in this mission depends on the answer. Override window: any time before mission merge.

payload.final_answer: Shrunk variant. PR #3898 is OPEN with the ADR at status Proposed at plan time (verified via gh 2026-09-06); the tasks-time gate 'merged AND Accepted' is not met. WP03 ships residue + the event_emitter.py:1-10 docstring correction pointing at the real E3 seam (status/adapters.py:364-366) + the FR-011 verified record (research/emitter-adr-inputs.md); emitter execution (collision, sync_emitter pass, flush-target adjudication, parity oracle) is minted as a follow-up WP/mission once the ADR lands. Re-check the gate at tasks-finalize; if the ADR merged meanwhile, WP03's scope grows per FR-012.

Ride this mission. team_projection tombstone, ActionContext alias (context.py:338 + __init__.py:127,139-142), and the 13 __all__ demotions land in WP03 (the residue slice). test_no_dead_symbols.py has ONE owner (WP01, for the DSL pins); WP03's re-pins for the demotions are a declared out-of-map edit sequenced after WP01 (dependency), so no two PRs and no two parallel WPs race on its hash pins. PR #3899's verified file list carries none of this residue.

Mission B WP04: a small WP that owns runtime/next/decision.py alone and deletes derive_mission_state (:187) and evaluate_guards (:218) plus tests/next/test_decision_unit.py's legacy section; sequenced after Mission A merges into the branch (mission-level ordering, C-001). Rationale: Mission A's WP05 is claimed and running with a deliberately small scope ('land small, land early' to free Mission B's files); adding a deletion rider mid-flight risks its review; the runtime ledger keeps the mission_v1 edge via next_invocation_lifecycle.py:332 so no ledger edit is triggered.

payload.question: PR #3898 merged 2026-09-06 with the ADR Accepted (rewire-ready consolidation). FR-012 is executable. Execute it inside WP03 or mint WP05?

payload.final_answer: Mint WP05 (depends on WP03). The Accepted ADR's execution is a code change across runtime_bridge.py, runtime_bridge_engine.py, _internal_runtime/events.py and the retrospective buffer call site, plus two red-first bug fixes (flush target, both paths) and seam-consolidation tests — too large and different in kind for WP03's residue slice. WP03 keeps its shrunk emitter items (docstring + FR-011 record), which WP05 supersedes. OD7 (01M1VAHPARWJKB35F6E1VH8ZTW) is superseded by this decision.
